Priya (Sales): Heads-up — FinSuite POC: streaming chat hangs when users are behind their corporate proxy. Non-streaming calls are fine. Can we triage? @Jordan
Max (FinSuite): Repro steps: using redwood-inference-js v0.9.1 on node 18.16. Set HTTPS_PROXY to http://proxy.fin:3128. Regular completions return quickly, but streaming chat.connect() opens and then no data flows. Client finally errors after ~2m: ‘socket hang up’.
Jordan (Solutions): Can you paste the minimal client snippet + env vars and any client-side error stack?
Max (FinSuite): Env: HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.fin:3128. Code: ```
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.KEY, baseURL: 'https://api.redwood.example' });
await client.chat.stream({messages}).on('data', (c)=> console.log(c));
``` No explicit http/https agent set.
Anika (Eng): Streaming in Node needs a tunneling agent when a proxy is in the middle. v0.9.1 should detect but proxies vary. Try explicit https-proxy-agent + keepAlive: ```
const { HttpsProxyAgent } = require('https-proxy-agent');
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent(process.env.HTTPS_PROXY);
const client = new RedwoodClient({ agent, timeout: 120000, streaming: true });
```
Jordan (Solutions): Also try setting SDK opts: heartbeatIntervalMs and disable stream buffering for immediate chunks.
Max (FinSuite): Tried agent. Now I see repeated ECONNRESET after ~30s. Proxy logs show CONNECT succeeded: ```[proxy] 10.4.5.6:54321 CONNECT api.redwood.example:443 - 200``` but then resets.
Anika (Eng): ECONNRESET on streaming usually means the proxy or a middlebox is closing idle persistent connections. Two mitigations: 1) enable keep-alive + shorter heartbeat ping from the SDK (e.g., 15s); 2) fallback to chunked long-polling if proxy blocks websockets/tunnels. Which can you accept for UX?
Priya (Sales): FinSuite needs streaming for the demo UX. Can Engineering propose a minimal change?
Jordan (Solutions): Quick test: Max, can you run the same code from a machine off the corp network (home) to confirm proxy-only?
Max (FinSuite): Confirmed — streaming works from home. So it's definitely proxy-related.
Anika (Eng): Short-term patch: set agent keepAlive true and a heartbeat. Example: ```
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent({ keepAlive: true, timeout: 0 });
const client = new RedwoodClient({ agent, streaming: true, heartbeatIntervalMs: 15000 });
``` Also set explicit header 'Connection: keep-alive'. We'll prepare a hotfix to make these defaults.
Jordan (Solutions): I'll send them a test package/snippet and update the POC playbook. Priya — flag this as an enterprise networking blocker and note Private/Dedicated as potential remedies if corp policy can't be changed.
Priya (Sales): Will do. I'll add that to the deal risk log and call out potential need for Private VPC.
Max (FinSuite): Applied the agent + heartbeat patch — streaming stable for 10+ minutes now, no ECONNRESET. Looks good on our end.
Anika (Eng): Great. We'll cut v0.9.2 tomorrow with improved proxy-agent detection, default keepAlive for Node, and heartbeat enabled. @deploy-bot please open a task.
deploy-bot: Created ticket #INF-4821 with label "hotfix/proxy-streaming"
Jordan (Solutions): Adding runbook note: 1) If corp proxy present, set HTTPS_PROXY and use https-proxy-agent with keepAlive; 2) Enable heartbeatIntervalMs; 3) If still blocked, request CONNECT to api.redwood.example:443 or opt for Private deployment.
Priya (Sales): Closing the triage — I'll update FinSuite execs and update the risk section. Great work everyone :tada:
